subject: math
question: 设 $a_{i} > 0 (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ ，记 $f(x) = \left( \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}^{x} \right)^{\frac{1}{x}}$ 。求极限 $I = \lim_{x \to 0} f(x)$ 与 $J = \lim_{x \to 0} \frac{1}{x} [f(x) - I]$ 。

steps.text: 分析 极限 $I$ 属于 $1^{\infty}$ 型，极限中有幂指函数，需要将幂指函数转化为指数函数来计算，可用洛必达法则或泰勒公式. 考虑到 $J$ 是 $I$ 的加边极限，所以都用泰勒公式计算为好.
a _ {i} ^ {x} = \mathrm{e} ^ {x \ln a _ {i}} = 1 + x \ln a _ {i} + \frac {1}{2} (x \ln a _ {i}) ^ {2} + o (x ^ {2}) \triangleq 1 + u _ {i},\tag{①}
再利用 $\ln (1 + x)$ 的泰勒公式，将上式化为

\begin{array}{r l} \ln \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} ^ {x}\right) & = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} u _ {i} - \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} u _ {i}\right) ^ {2} + o (u _ {i} ^ {2}) \\ & = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x \ln a _ {i} + \frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x \ln a _ {i}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x \ln a _ {i}\right) ^ {2} + o (x ^ {2}) \\ & = \frac {x}{n} \ln (a _ {1} a _ {2} \dots a _ {n}) + \frac {x ^ {2}}{2 n} \left[ \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (\ln a _ {i}) ^ {2} - \frac {1}{n} \ln^ {2} (a _ {1} a _ {2} \dots a _ {n}) \right] + o (x ^ {2}). \end{array}\tag{②}

cdps.expected: 展开阶数不低于目标表达式中保留的最低阶无穷小阶数。
